O.outcome_detail: problem-solving accuracy on the MathDial problem set with SymPy

cells.quote: Model o3-mini(high) and Claude 3.5 Sonnet obtained the highest accuracy, of 90.00%, followed by Gemini 2.0 Flash (88.67%) with GPT-4o (78.67%) and GPT-4o-mini (77.33%) obtaining the lowest scores.
cells.note: Model-level benchmark comparison; the study does not report human learners, assignment, or an effect size.
